checkpoint.title: Celadon to Saffron: the TEA to Route 7's gate guard, heal at Saffron's Center

events.why: out of Celadon's Center (its ground floor coded), east through the city onto Route 7 and, in two legs that end at walls, to the gate's west wall a row below its door (15, 10): south down column 7 to the row behind the underground path house's roof, where row 12 stops the player, then east to the gate. Dead-reckoned, the walk ran a column long on the crossing east (the game didn't hold the player up there) and the hold south down column 8 hopped its ledge, which took two of its tiles, and ended a row short, against the gate's wall (console B, 2026-11-14 20:23 and 20:27); held to walls, column 7 or 8 ends on row 11 alike
a step north onto the door's tile (15, 10), east through the gate's west door (pokeguy bikes, 1:27:07 to 1:27:30), to (5, 4), a tile west of the guard's top trigger (6, 4)

onto the guard's top trigger (6, 4) (Route7_EastEntrance_EventScript_GuardTriggerTop): the player turns to the guard (6, 2) and stays on the tile (Route7_EastEntrance_Movement_WalkToGuardTop is a walk in place)

the guard takes the TEA (FLAG_GOT_TEA, Route7_EastEntrance_EventScript_GiveTea), shares it and lets the player through: VAR_MAP_SCENE_ROUTE5_ROUTE6_ROUTE7_ROUTE8_GATES 1 shuts every gate's triggers (pokeguy 1:27:30 to 1:27:43)
east out of the gate into Saffron City (8, 27), and through the city, round the Rocket Grunts who stand and walk there until Silph Co. (FLAG_HIDE_SAFFRON_ROCKETS), to below the Center's door (24, 38)
the Center script in: through the door and up to the nurse; no map of the Center. It also makes Saffron a Fly point
full HP and PP before the Fighting Dojo's five Black Belts

checkpoint: Starts at Celadon's nurse, facing her, where 14.04 ends.

The TEA comes from Celadon Mansion 1F's tea woman, which segment 10 or 11.01 is to cover (outline: pokeguy has it from 1:11). Without it the guard says he's thirsty and walks the player back west (Route7_EastEntrance_Movement_BlockPlayerEntry), and the route after this fails.
PokeGuy goes straight to Silph Co. (1:27:44); the Fighting Dojo's Hitmonchan is a user-approved deviation for a Gift RNG. This row ends at Saffron's nurse, where the Dojo checkpoints start.

Not authored yet, blocked: the Dojo itself (15.02: the Black Belts and KOICHI to the Poke Balls, saved facing HITMONCHAN's; 15.03: after Gift RNG, leave_gift_summary, deposit, save). SaffronCity_Dojo isn't in the pinned map pack (PokemonSimulation bdca47c), and Gift RNG knows only the Magikarp salesman.
